payload.reason: The evidence provides specific factors that contribute to the stability of word embeddings, including properties of the words, data, and algorithms used.

claims.text: The stability of word embeddings is influenced by properties of the words themselves, such as frequency and part-of-speech.
The choice of algorithm and its parameters significantly affect the stability of word embeddings.
Curriculum learning, or the order in which words appear in training data, is a key factor in the stability of embeddings.
Document properties also play a role in the stability of word embeddings.
